case.status: Entirely fictional teaching case; every case document and event is simulated
case.promise: 10000 approved packaging labels, artwork v3, received and accepted by the named customer authority at the agreed Montreal warehouse by 2026-11-12 16:00 America/Toronto; no short shipment or quality substitution is authorized

cost_rows.label: Coordination including the case overhead allocation

case.cash_notes: The original customer's invoice is outside the continuity service ledger. The advance is neither extra revenue nor a grant. The 1800 ending cash includes 1200 starting money. This exercise assumes the listed cost scope is complete, amounts are on one consistent basis, and no other cash obligations exist; a real pilot must establish its own complete ledger and timing. The 3500 advance must actually be received and available before the modeled outflows, with agreed failure/refund terms. Do not invent a liability-free advance.
case.capstone: Staged tabletop evidence: unfunded initial plan; authoritative order amendment and permissions; funded and consented route; mock receipt accepts 9800, so the original 10000-label outcome fails. A clearly separate optional rerun packet may supply a new mock receipt accepting 10000 within conditions. Preserve the earlier failure. Every conclusion stays limited to the tabletop; actual physical delivery and a real market remain not established. The funding-success arithmetic is explicitly conditional on full acceptance and receipt of the 2100 balance. Failure/refund and unpaid obligations must remain visible in the failed run.

page.id: stable lowercase ID, same across languages
page.title: short descriptive heading

blocks.text: Connected prose; **bold** allowed; source refs [C1, pp. 7–8] where relevant

blocks.label: Worked example or Practice or Feedback
blocks.text: Presented as plain bold lead-in in Word and restrained typography in PDF

authoring_schema.layout: One authored page becomes one PDF page and one Word page unless explicitly split after review. Body area about 500–550 points. Target 180–260 words per normal page, fewer with a diagram or fields; maximum 320. Cover/navigation/source pages added by root, so do not duplicate. Avoid table cells with long essays. 3-column tables need very concise labels. Keep titles under about 60 characters where practical. Never claim a live operational experiment occurred in course creation.

deliverables.workbook: Approximately 16 authored pages; genuine fillable PDF plus editable Word
deliverables.facilitator: Approximately 16–18 authored pages including worked answers, session script, rubric and quiz answer key
deliverables.quiz: 12 bilingual objective questions, meaningful distractors and clear explanations; unvalidated learning check, not business certification
deliverables.slides: About 24 teaching slides in each language with speaker notes, companion PDF, exact case tables and source citations
deliverables.reader: Offline bilingual full-content HTML reader with search, progress and quiz; no external services or secrets
